Exactly preserve the original differences, bends and rotations from image1. Do not add forearms, entire characters or extra hands. Genuine transparent background, no labels, text, numbers, grid, border, shadows or scenery. All marks must belong to the hand artwork. Thin stylized female assassin hands matching approved illustration, readable small game sprites.
